purpose: Determine whether and when on-policy teacher distillation improves a smaller math model, while refusing to build scientific claims on unhealthy generation, weak teachers, broken baselines, or plumbing-only success.
global_claim_boundary: A downstream stage may launch only from a fresh, immutable semantic result artifact that passes every registered requirement. Slurm completion, finite loss, nonzero KL, checkpoint creation, or a hand-inspected example never satisfies a scientific gate.

automation_policy.rescue_policy: No in-place rescue. A failed scientific gate is terminal for that registered recipe. A materially changed prompt, scorer, cap, sampler, optimizer, dataset, or checkpoint rule requires a new campaign version and fresh setup-only evidence.

stages.result: The O teacher has a small symbolic-eligible held-out gain, but predecessor teacher/student recipes are low-signal and truncation-dominated.

stages.selection_data: first 64 registered O student_opd records only
stages.pass_action: Freeze the smallest passing student cap across all student arms and the smallest passing teacher cap across paired teacher arms.
stages.conditional_action: If a family fails 2048 and 4096, run 8192 for that family only.
stages.terminal_failure: If 8192 fails, stop model training and register a separate compact-prompt qualification campaign on fresh setup-only records.

stages.purpose: Remove the mismatch between the TRL-style teacher reward and the repository evaluation reward before another teacher run.

requirements.training_verifier_unknown_policy: discard the complete prompt group without an optimizer step; abort if unknown fraction exceeds 0.001
requirements.evaluation_unknown_policy: retain bounded unknowns; never retry until a favorable verdict

stages.pass_action: Freeze reward_contract_v2 and its disagreement report.
stages.terminal_failure: Do not retrain a teacher while train/eval reward semantics remain unregistered or outcome-adaptive.

stages.scope: One O-teacher recipe-development seed on setup/tune-dev data; final teacher_gap_dev remains unopened.

fixed_design_requirements.one_factor_at_a_time: First qualify group signal at fixed 250-step ceiling; only then test the 500-step ceiling.

stages.terminal_failure: If neither registered group-size/step recipe passes, preserve the negative result and stop O-teacher-dependent OPD.

stages.scope: Freeze the selected O-teacher recipe, train seeds 0, 1, and 2, then open complete teacher_gap_dev once per seed.
stages.terminal_failure: No OPD launch if the frozen teacher does not reproduce a robust held-out skill gap.

stages.scope: Raw and task-RL Qwen3-1.7B under the selected student cap and reward_contract_v2.
stages.terminal_failure: If matched task-RL cannot improve the raw student on tune-dev, stop and diagnose the student training recipe before OPD.

stages.scope: One-step and no-update custody diagnostics on exact student trajectories.
stages.terminal_failure: Do not launch OPD when the qualified teacher has no likelihood or task advantage on the student's own trajectories.

stages.scope: One frozen development seed; tune-dev only.
stages.terminal_failure: If reward-gated OPD does not add value on tune-dev, preserve the characterization result and do not run the confirmatory matrix.

stages.scope: Three frozen seeds with one final evaluation opening.
stages.claim_rule: Report the complete matrix and seed heterogeneity regardless of sign. No post-hoc rescue arm enters the confirmatory result.

stages.scope: MOPD/routed multi-teacher characterization, never part of the minimal single-teacher claim.
candidate_questions: Does routing by per-trajectory teacher advantage outperform the best single teacher?
Do multiple teachers add coverage or merely average incompatible distributions?
Does top-k KL preserve teacher complementarity relative to full-vocabulary K1?
